run_GDPPLoss: run GDPPLoss with discriminator feature tensors phiFake and phiReal to compute the GDPP loss value
build_GAN_training_with_GDPP: build a GAN training loop that uses GDPPLoss to penalize mode collapse by comparing real and fake feature diversity
test_GDPPLoss_backward: test GDPPLoss backward pass by calling with backward=True to perform gradient computation via retain_graph
review_GDPPLoss_compute_diversity: review the GDPPLoss compute_diversity nested function that normalizes features and computes eigenvalues via symeig
summarize_GDPPLoss: summarize the GDPPLoss function that computes magnitude loss and weighted structure loss from real and fake discriminator features
